valueString.value: define "MedicationAdministrations": [MedicationAdministration]

define "EncounterInpatient": ([Encounter: "Encounter Inpatient"] union [Encounter: class in {"inpatient encounter", "inpatient acute", "inpatient non-acute", "short stay"}]) Encounters where Encounters.status in {'in-progress', 'finished', 'triaged', 'onleave', 'entered-in-error'} and Encounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period"

define "EncounterObservation": ([Encounter: "Observation Services"] union [Encounter: class in {"observation encounter"}]) Encounters where Encounters.status in {'in-progress', 'finished', 'triaged', 'onleave', 'entered-in-error'} and Encounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period"
Encounters with Patient Hospital Locations

define "Encounters with Patient Hospital Locations": [Encounter] Encounters where exists( Encounters.location EncounterLocation where Global.GetLocation(EncounterLocation.location).type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations" and EncounterLocation.period overlaps Encounters.period and Encounters.status in {'in-progress', 'finished', 'triaged', 'onleave', 'entered-in-error' } and Encounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period" )
Initial Population
SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Administered

define "SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Administered": "MedicationAdministrations" RPSMedAdmin let Meds: GetMedicationCode(RPSMedAdmin.medication) where (Meds in "Anakinra" or Meds in "Bamlanivimab" or Meds in "Baloxavir" or Meds in "Baricitinib" or Meds in "Bebtelovimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab / Imdevimab" or Meds in "COVID19 RxNorm Value Set for Tocilizumab" or Meds in "Etesevimab" or Meds in "Imdevimab" or Meds in "Molnupiravir" or Meds in "Nirmatrelvir / Ritonavir" or Meds in "Oseltamivir" or Meds in "Peramivir" or Meds in "Remdesivir" or Meds in "Sarilumab" or Meds in "Sotrovimab" or Meds in "Tofacitinib" or Meds in "Zanamivir") and RPSMedAdmin.status ~ 'completed' and exists("Initial Population") and Global."Normalize Interval"(RPSMedAdmin.effective) during "Measurement Period" return SharedResource.MedicationAdministrationResourceBaseFHIR(RPSMedAdmin)
RSV DiagnosticReport Result from Lab

define "RSV DiagnosticReport Result from Lab": "DiagnosticReports" Reports where (GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "RSV (Tests for RSV Nucleic Acid)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "RSV (Tests for RSV Antigen)") and Reports.status in {'final','registered','preliminary','partial'} and exists("Initial Population")
SDE RSV DiagnosticReport Result from Lab
RSV Observation

define "RSV Observation": ([Observation: "RSV (Tests for RSV Nucleic Acid)"] union [Observation: "RSV (Tests for RSV Antigen)"] ) Observations where exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "laboratory") and Observations.status in {'final','registered','preliminary','partial'} and exists("Initial Population")
RSV PRE Admission Observation
SDE RSV Specimen
COVID and Influenza DiagnosticReport Result from Lab

//retrieve DiagnosticReport result based on 14 or 8 day lookback define "COVID and Influenza DiagnosticReport Result from Lab": "DiagnosticReports" Reports where (GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Nucleic Acid)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Antigen)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Nucleic Acid)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Antigen)") and Reports.status in {'final','registered','preliminary','partial'} and exists("Initial Population")
RPS DiagnosticReport Result from Lab
define "RPS DiagnosticReport Result from Lab": "COVID and Influenza DiagnosticReport Result from Lab" union "RSV DiagnosticReport Result from Lab"
SDE RPS DiagnosticReport Result from Lab
SDE RSV PRE Admission Observation
SDE Isolation Precautions Implemented

define "SDE Isolation Precautions Implemented": [Procedure: "Transmission Based Precaution Types"] IsolationPrecautions where Global."Normalize Interval"(IsolationPrecautions.performed) during "Measurement Period" and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ProcedureResource(IsolationPrecautions, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-procedure'}})
COVID And Influenza Observation
COVID And Influenza PRE Admission Observation
SDE COVID And Influenza Specimen
RPS Observation
define "RPS Observation": "RSV Observation" union "COVID And Influenza Observation"
SDE RPS Specimen
RSV DiagnosticReport
SDE RSV DiagnosticReport
SDE RPSObservation
SDE All ServiceRequests
COVID And Influenza DiagnosticReport
SDE COVID And Influenza DiagnosticReport
SDE COVID And Influenza PRE Admission Observation
SDE RPS ServiceRequest

define "SDE RPS ServiceRequest": ([ServiceRequest: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Nucleic Acid)"] union [ServiceRequest: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Antigen)"] union [ServiceRequest: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Nucleic Acid)"] union [ServiceRequest: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Antigen)"] union [ServiceRequest: "RSV (Tests for RSV Nucleic Acid)"] union [ServiceRequest: "RSV (Tests for RSV Antigen)"] ) ServiceRequests where ServiceRequests.intent ~ 'order' and ServiceRequests.status ~ 'completed' and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ServiceRequestResourceBaseFHIR(ServiceRequests)
SDE COVID and Influenza DiagnosticReport Result from Lab
SDE All Procedures
SDE Location

define "SDE Location": [Location] Locations where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.LocationResource(Locations, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-location'}})
SDE Encounter Discharge Dispositions

define "SDE Encounter Discharge Dispositions": "Initial Population" DischargeDispositions where DischargeDispositions.hospitalization.dischargeDisposition in "Discharge Disposition" return SharedResource.EncounterResource(DischargeDispositions, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-encounter'}})
RPS DiagnosticReport
define "RPS DiagnosticReport": "COVID And Influenza DiagnosticReport" union "RSV DiagnosticReport"
SDE RPS DiagnosticReport
define "MedicationRequests": [MedicationRequest]
SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Ordered

define "SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Ordered": "MedicationRequests" RPSMedRequest let Meds: (GetMedicationCode(RPSMedRequest.medication)) where (Meds in "Anakinra" or Meds in "Baloxavir" or Meds in "Bamlanivimab" or Meds in "Baricitinib" or Meds in "Bebtelovimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab / Imdevimab" or Meds in "COVID19 RxNorm Value Set for Tocilizumab" or Meds in "Etesevimab" or Meds in "Imdevimab" or Meds in "Molnupiravir" or Meds in "Nirmatrelvir / Ritonavir" or Meds in "Oseltamivir" or Meds in "Peramivir" or Meds in "Remdesivir" or Meds in "Sarilumab" or Meds in "Sotrovimab" or Meds in "Tofacitinib" or Meds in "Zanamivir") and exists("Initial Population") and Global."Normalize Interval"(RPSMedRequest.authoredOn) during "Measurement Period" return SharedResource.MedicationRequestResource(RPSMedRequest, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-medicationrequest'}})
SDE Minimal Patient
define "Observations": [Observation]
SDE All Observations
SDE Medication

define "SDE Medication": ("SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Ordered" union "SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Administered") MedReqOrAdmin where MedReqOrAdmin.medication is FHIR.Reference return SharedResource.MedicationResource(GetMedicationFrom(MedReqOrAdmin.medication), {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-medication'}})
